record.title: Elevated errors affecting the Microsoft 365 connector

updates.body: We’re investigating an issue with Microsoft connectors where new connections may be broken and tools are not working as expected. We’ll share an update when we know more.
We’re seeing signs of recovery for the Microsoft 365 connector and are continuing to monitor the affected services to confirm recovery.
All affected services are operating normally again. We’re sorry for the disruption, and we appreciate your patience.
